decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is a hardware option whose absence from the website after 2019 suggests its market value has not materialized, so the firm abandons the option and reallocates resources.
As a low-cost software module building on established systems, it remains an inexpensive option with unresolved niche value, so the firm keeps it open.
The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces is a hardware product that has had several years to prove its value, and its lack of market presence indicates the option is no longer worth keeping.
The mobile app is a low-cost digital option that can be maintained cheaply while its user base and integration value remain uncertain.
The inline code verification system aligns with the firm's shift toward serialization and traceability, and its building on established offer makes it a valuable low-cost option to keep.
The print layout design software is an inexpensive digital add-on whose prospects remain uncertain, so the firm keeps the option open.
